Summary

- Briefly describe the feature you’re proposing.

Motivation / Problem

- Why is this needed? What problem does it solve?

Proposed solution / Approach

- How would you implement it? (architecture, API, UI/UX, etc.)

Alternatives

- List any alternatives you considered or tried.

Acceptance criteria

- Provide 2–4 verifiable criteria in Given/When/Then format.

Additional context

- Screenshots, examples, related docs/issues/PRs.
